summary: Defines the ipp: URL scheme, used to give the network location of a print service that speaks the Internet Printing Protocol, or of a printer or other resource it manages. It expands and clarifies the IPP URL section of RFC 2910. It is a proposed standard.

eli5.summary: Every printer on a network needs an address so computers can find it. This memo says how to write that address so it clearly points to a printer that understands the Internet Printing Protocol.

questions: how to write an ipp printer address
